description: Maricopa County Regional Work Zone Data Exchange (WZDx) v3.0 Feed Sample is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by Maricopa County Department of Transportation (MCDOT) --- Recommended Citation: "Maricopa County Department of Transportation. (2020). Maricopa County Regional Work Zone Data Exchange (WZDx) v3.0 Feed Sample. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from https://doi.org/10.21949/1520083”. The WZDx Specification enables infrastructure owners and operators (IOOs) to make harmonized work zone data available for third party use. The intent is to make travel on public roads safer and more efficient through ubiquitous access to data on work zone activity. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 51 columns, among them data_source_location_verify_method, data_source_update_frequency, road_number, beginning_cross_street, start_date, start_date_accuracy. The portal shows 2021-10-23 as the last data update. Attribution given: Maricopa County Department of Transportation (MCDOT) --- Recommended Citation: "Maricopa County Department of Transporta. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
